claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission of NASA's Artemis program.
Artemis II is targeted for launch no earlier than Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is targeted to launch from Kennedy Space Center's Pad 39B in Florida.
Artemis II is aimed at taking four astronauts on a 10-day flight around the moon and back.
Artemis II follows the successful uncrewed Artemis I test flight.
Artemis I test flight occurred in November 2022.
Artemis I test flight was uncrewed.
Artemis I test flight was successful.
Artemis I is the first in the series of moon missions.
